featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with SuperBottoms. The customer service is extremely poor and unresponsive. Despite placing my order well in advance, the product was not delivered even after 8 days, which is completely unacceptable.

It seems like there is no control over their delivery partners, and the coordination among their staff is seriously lacking. Every time I reached out for an update, I received vague or inconsistent responses, with no real resolution.

Good thing is they refunded the amount very quickly.

Overall, the entire experience was frustrating and inconvenient. I would not recommend SuperBottoms based on their unreliable service
